description: This file contains the implementation of a PDO SQL Server driver and related record set classes for the ADOdb database abstraction library in PHP. It defines classes for handling SQL Server-specific behavior and metadata retrieval through PDO.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_sqlsrv
classes.description: A class that implements the PDO SQL Server driver, extending the general ADODB_pdo class with SQL Server-specific configurations and methods such as setting transaction modes and retrieving metadata.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_pdo_sqlsrv
classes.description: A record set class for handling SQL Server results via PDO, providing methods to fetch field metadata with SQL Server-specific details.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_pdo_sqlsrv
classes.description: An extension of the PDO SQL Server record set class that handles record sets stored as arrays, with a method to fetch field metadata similar to the PDO SQL Server version.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the PDO SQL Server driver settings and properties in the parent driver object.

methods.name: setTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the database connection based on the provided mode.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Stub method returning false; intended to retrieve metadata about table columns.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Stub method returning false; intended to retrieve metadata about tables.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Delegates to the general ADOConnection method to limit the results of a query.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information via the ADOConnection method.

methods.name: fetchField
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific field in the result set, with support for SQL Server specific data and case normalization.
